proposals.evidence: CDIAL 1821 The utpātaka article explicitly gives Nepali upiũ, plural upiyā̃ flea, while questioning a connection to utpiba. Survey upiya/upiyã flea follows this exact regional comparison with the alternative deeper analysis retained. Exact form upiyã is preserved; possible intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
